entry.title: v1.2.0-build9 released
entry.summary: Render paths can now be switched live, without restarting the application (the BlinkShift public API). A switch takes a few hundred milliseconds in our test environment and rolls back automatically if the new path fails its render check. Also adds blink_gtk_application_run() for correct GtkApplication integration and a presentation-policy API, and fixes large user scripts never reaching the renderer.

entry.title: v1.2.0-build8 released
entry.summary: Applied the results of a security review. Per-site process isolation is now on by default — the boundary that stops a compromised page reading another site's data. Opening several sites now uses more renderer processes, which can increase memory use. Sandbox availability is now measured rather than inferred, and there is a new API to query the sandbox state. A reference page for environment variables is also published.

entry.title: v1.2.0-build7 released
entry.summary: The header shipped with the development package claimed the previous release (this affects every v1.2.0 build from build1 through build6). The runtime API was always correct, so only compile-time macros were affected. Nothing includes that header, so builds kept succeeding — which is why it went unnoticed for so long. The runtime itself is identical to build6; Chromium was not rebuilt.

entry.title: v1.2.0-build6 released
entry.summary: The rendering engine is now Chromium 151.0.7922.108, fixing defects in the paths that close windows, hide windows, and handle input. User scripts you register now run before the page's own scripts, and JavaScript results come back as JSON.

entry.title: Western hyphenation now works
entry.summary: Specifying hyphens: auto now breaks Western words at appropriate points, with dictionaries for 52 languages bundled. Justified Western text depends on hyphenation, so previously the shorter the line the wider the word gaps became.

entry.title: Install and update with dnf
entry.summary: Register the repository once and dnf upgrade keeps you current. Packages are signed and the repository ships with gpgcheck=1.

entry.title: v1.2.0-build4 released
entry.summary: Continuously animating pages — Canvas, CSS animation, video — no longer freeze in software mode.

entry.title: GPU rendering works with a single environment variable
entry.summary: Switch to the GPU path with BLINKGTK_GPU_MODE=egl alone. No application code changes required.

entry.title: Reported a vertical-writing line-breaking issue upstream
entry.summary: In vertical writing, a closing bracket at the line end can leave the line half filled. Reported upstream with reproduction steps and measurements.

entry.title: Updated to Chromium 151
entry.summary: Emphasis marks no longer inflate line pitch, and ruby overhang behaves as specified.
